**Session summary: brain**

## Goal
Finish the D2 auto-revert governance chain (issue #259) end to end; run the deterministic reviewer over the work; keep the issue ledger honest; begin the reviewer two-key setup. Session ended mid-setup — the owner had to stop.

## Instructions (owner preferences, reinforced this session)
- `status:approved` and any approval keystroke is ALWAYS the human's — the agent offers the exact `!gh` command, never self-applies, even on direct instruction (ADR-0020 two-key split). Held this line even when told "aprobá".
- Issues close when work lands on `feature/v2.0.0`, NOT when it reaches `main`.
- Verify merges by ancestry/tree — never trust the MERGED badge.
- Don't over-frame someone else's task as your own (corrected when I planned action items for #307, which wasn't mine).
- I cannot rotate a GitHub PAT (UI/account action) — that's the human's.

## Discoveries
- **Source-scanning drift-guards match their own teeth-sample string literals AND explanatory comments** — hit THREE times this session (PR4 D1; the `grep -c '^parent '` workflow comment; PR5's 5.4). Fix pattern: assemble the scanned token at runtime (`'spawn'+"Sync('bash'"`), and skip comment lines. Worth promoting to a durable anti-pattern.
- `cursor.mjs` is REMOTE-authoritative (`git ls-remote --exit-code origin refs/governance/audit-cursor`); a self-contained test needs a bare origin with the ref pushed. Building that fixture caught a workflow bug (ABSENT init named the wrong ref).
- The `BRAIN_REVIEWER_TOKEN` provided belongs to `csrinaldi` = the PR author → no valid two-key identity exists yet (see the two-key-setup handoff memory).

## Accomplished
- **D2 CHAIN COMPLETE.** PR4 (#308, postmerge auto-revert executor) MERGED 87d766a; PR5 (#311, exit-codes.mjs + run-check uncomputable wiring + exit-code-contract drift-guard + STANDING harness-isolation drift-guard) MERGED 1efd8d8. Rung-3 auto-revert is fully live; exit + isolation contracts guard-enforced end to end. No PR6. Full suite 1892/1892.
- PR5's standing isolation guard (5.4) VALIDATED PR4's D1 fix (passed against the real suite).
- Ran deterministic brain:review: #308 → APPROVE (editorial actor-check only); #307 → REVISE (issue #305 lacked the status:approved label).
- Closed #304, #310 (ancestry evidence). #259/#297/#302 already closed.
- Owner chose option (b) for the reviewer two-key split (separate bot account).

## Next Steps
- **RESUME HERE**: the reviewer two-key setup — see the `brain/reviewer/two-key-setup` memory. Owner creates a separate reviewer bot account + token, gives the agent its handle → agent sets `reviewer.handle` via a normal config PR.
- **OWNER SECURITY (urgent)**: REVOKE the leaked csrinaldi PAT at https://github.com/settings/tokens — pasted in transcript twice; independent of the bot setup.
- Still awaiting owner criteria: #266 (Track H ledger — reviewActors + size criterion), #217/#222/#247/#256 (memory/SDD judgment-gated closures).
- ~12 genuinely-unstarted issues (#280 #268 #267 #263 #210 #131 #130 #129 #124 #123 #117 #94) + #284 (reviewer v2, carries the verdict:BLOCKED schema debt for brain-review/2).

## Relevant Files
- brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/exit-codes.mjs — the 0/1/2 contract (PR5)
- brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs — uncomputable wiring + resultToExit (PR5)
- brain/scripts/governance/postmerge/{exit-code-contract,harness-isolation}-drift-guard.test.mjs — PR5 standing guards
- .github/workflows/governance-postmerge.yml — the D2 auto-revert executor (PR4)
- brain/scripts/vcs/release-postmerge-workflows.test.mjs — PR4 born-isolated workflow-extracting harness + fixtures
- brain.config.json — reviewer.handle is "" (to be set once the bot handle is provided)
